text: 7月28日，中国人民银行公布数据显示，2026年二季度末，金融机构人民币各项贷款余额282.63万亿元，同比增长5.2%，上半年人民币贷款增加10.72万亿元。企事业单位贷款增长平稳，工业中长期贷款总体平稳增长，普惠小微贷款保持增长，绿色贷款稳步增长，涉农贷款增长较为平稳，房地产贷款有所放缓，贷款支持科创企业力度保持稳定，住户经营性贷款同比小幅增长。（央视新闻）
text_en: On July 28, the People's Bank of China (PBOC) released data showing that at the end of Q2 2026, financial institutions' total RMB loans stood at 282.63 trillion yuan, up 5.2% year-on-year, with an increase of 10.72 trillion yuan in H1. Loans to enterprises and public institutions grew steadily; medium- and long-term industrial loans rose generally steadily; inclusive small and micro loans maintained growth; green loans grew steadily; agricultural loans grew relatively steadily; real estate loans slowed; loan support for tech-innovation firms remained stable; household operating loans saw a slight year-on-year increase. (CCTV)
